server.name: io.github.IvanBBaev/facebook-mcp
server.description: Facebook Pages MCP server for the Meta Graph API — publishing, insights, moderation, messaging

environmentVariables.description: System-user access token (Business Manager). Takes precedence over FB_ACCESS_TOKEN and FB_PAGE_TOKEN when several are set.
environmentVariables.name: FB_SYSTEM_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Primary user access token. At least one of FB_SYSTEM_TOKEN, FB_ACCESS_TOKEN or FB_PAGE_TOKEN must be set.
environmentVariables.name: FB_ACCESS_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Long-lived Page access token used as a fallback credential when no user or system-user token is configured. It belongs to exactly one Page, so set FB_PAGE_ID to that Page ID alongside it (the doctor / facebook_whoami reports it as the acting Page); a Page token without its Page ID is bound to nothing.
environmentVariables.name: FB_PAGE_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Meta app ID; combined with FB_APP_SECRET it forms the app access token used to authorize /debug_token inspection.
environmentVariables.name: FB_APP_ID

environmentVariables.description: Meta app secret. When set, appsecret_proof is attached to every call so a stolen bare token cannot be used on its own.
environmentVariables.name: FB_APP_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Default Facebook Page ID, used when a tool call omits an explicit profile argument. Required when FB_PAGE_TOKEN is the only credential: it names the Page that token belongs to.
environmentVariables.name: FB_PAGE_ID

environmentVariables.description: Graph API version to target. Defaults to the tested pinned version; other values are accepted verbatim as an escape hatch but are not tested.
environmentVariables.name: FB_API_VERSION

environmentVariables.description: Marketing API version the ads tools target (ad accounts, campaigns, ad sets, ads, insights, async reports). The Marketing API retires versions on its own, shorter schedule, so it is pinned separately from FB_API_VERSION. Other values are accepted verbatim as an escape hatch but are not tested.
environmentVariables.name: FB_ADS_API_VERSION

environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds; integer in [1, 600000].
environmentVariables.name: FB_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of in-flight requests per Graph host; integer in [1, 64].
environmentVariables.name: FB_HOST_CONCURRENCY

environmentVariables.description: Character budget applied by the result shaper before a tool result is truncated; integer in [500, 10000000].
environmentVariables.name: FB_MAX_RESULT_CHARS

environmentVariables.description: Write gating mode: plan (validating dry-run preview, the default) or apply. It never covers the irreversible and spend tiers, which always need a per-call apply plus a plan_id.
environmentVariables.name: FB_WRITE_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Operator confirmation token for out-of-band approval of irreversible or spend actions. The server prompts through MCP elicitation where the client supports it; otherwise the caller passes this value as the confirm_token tool argument. At least 16 characters — a shorter value fails startup; mint one with openssl rand -hex 32.
environmentVariables.name: FB_CONFIRM_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Directory permitted for local media uploads. Unset means URL-only uploads and no local file access at all.
environmentVariables.name: FB_MEDIA_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Path to the append-only write journal. Defaults to the XDG/%APPDATA% state path; the file is created owner-only (0600) and rotates by size.
environmentVariables.name: FB_JOURNAL_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Path to the small JSON file where facebook_get_activity_since keeps, per Page, the horizon of the last complete read. Defaults to the XDG/%APPDATA% state path next to the journal; the file holds Page ids and timestamps only and is written atomically, owner-only (0600).
environmentVariables.name: FB_ACTIVITY_STATE_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Directory where the insights tools write a CSV or JSON file when called with `output`. Defaults to `exports/` under the XDG/%APPDATA% state path. Files are written atomically and owner-only (0600) and are never overwritten; a name collision gets a numeric suffix.
environmentVariables.name: FB_EXPORT_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool packages or profiles to expose (e.g. core,posts,reader, or the profiles core|all|reader|publisher|moderator|ads). Omit for the default profile, which excludes ads.
environmentVariables.name: FB_TOOL_PACKAGES

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated packages OR profiles to exclude even when FB_TOOL_PACKAGES enables them; deny wins over allow. Profile names expand here exactly as they do in FB_TOOL_PACKAGES, and a profile beats a same-spelled package, so FB_PACKAGES_DENY=core denies the whole six-package core profile rather than the single core package. The core package is then forced back on regardless, because its identity and diagnostic tools are what you need to debug the surface you just narrowed. An unrecognized name is a startup error, not a silently ignored token.
environmentVariables.name: FB_PACKAGES_DENY

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated packages OR profiles whose write tools are not registered at all; the read tools of those packages stay available. Profile names expand as they do in FB_TOOL_PACKAGES, so FB_PACKAGES_READONLY=core makes every default package read-only in one token. An unrecognized name is a startup error.
environmentVariables.name: FB_PACKAGES_READONLY

environmentVariables.description: Transport protocol: stdio (default) or http. The http transport binds 127.0.0.1 only and fails closed without FB_HTTP_TOKEN.
environmentVariables.name: FB_TRANSPORT

environmentVariables.description: Bearer token guarding the HTTP transport; required when FB_TRANSPORT=http (the server refuses to start without it). At least 16 characters — a shorter value is refused (under stdio it is dropped with a warning); mint one with openssl rand -hex 32.
environmentVariables.name: FB_HTTP_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Port for the HTTP transport (loopback only); used when FB_TRANSPORT=http. Integer in [1, 65535].
environmentVariables.name: FB_HTTP_PORT

environmentVariables.description: Default ad account ID (act_… or the bare numeric id) for the opt-in ads package.
environmentVariables.name: FB_AD_ACCOUNT_ID

environmentVariables.description: Hard ceiling for any ads budget write, in minor units of the ad account's own currency (e.g. cents for USD). Non-negative integer; a write above it is refused. No currency conversion: size it for the account's currency (1000 is $10 but only 1000 JPY).
environmentVariables.name: FB_ADS_BUDGET_CEILING

environmentVariables.description: Largest campaign spend_cap (the lifetime total a campaign may spend) that an ads write may set, in minor units of the ad account's own currency. Non-negative integer; a cap above it is refused, never clamped. Unset: every write that sets a campaign spend cap is refused. No currency conversion, same as FB_ADS_BUDGET_CEILING.
environmentVariables.name: FB_ADS_CAMPAIGN_SPEND_CAP_MAX

environmentVariables.description: Stderr log verbosity: debug, info, warn or error. Logs never go to stdout — that is the stdio protocol channel.
environmentVariables.name: FB_LOG_LEVEL

server.name: io.github.IvanBBaev/servicenow-mcp-ai

environmentVariables.description: ServiceNow instance host, e.g. dev12345.service-now.com.
environmentVariables.name: SN_INSTANCE

environmentVariables.description: Username for basic auth or the OAuth password grant.
environmentVariables.name: SN_USER

environmentVariables.description: Password for basic auth or the OAuth password grant.
environmentVariables.name: SN_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Auth mode: basic | oauth | apikey | token | none. Auto-detected from the keys present if omitted.
environmentVariables.name: SN_AUTH

environmentVariables.description: ServiceNow API key, sent as the x-sn-apikey header (apikey auth).
environmentVariables.name: SN_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Which tool packages to expose, e.g. discovery (default), all, or a comma-separated list.
environmentVariables.name: SN_TOOL_PACKAGES

token.description: The deployment's SN_HTTP_TOKEN, or an access token from its OAuth issuer (SN_HTTP_OAUTH_ISSUER).

servicenow_mcp_ai_host.description: Host of your own deployment of the server in HTTP mode (SN_TRANSPORT=http behind TLS); there is no hosted instance.

server.name: io.github.IvanBBaev/x-mcp-ai
server.description: Safety-first X (Twitter) API v2 MCP server: 41 typed tools across 12 packages, policy-gated.

environmentVariables.description: Authentication mode: oauth2 (default) or app-only.
environmentVariables.name: X_MCP_AUTH_MODE

environmentVariables.description: OAuth 2.0 client ID (oauth2 mode).
environmentVariables.name: X_MCP_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: OAuth 2.0 client secret (confidential clients only).
environmentVariables.name: X_MCP_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Application-only bearer token (app-only mode).
environmentVariables.name: X_MCP_BEARER_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Path to the rotating OAuth 2.0 token store (default: OS-resolved).
environmentVariables.name: X_MCP_TOKEN_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to keep OAuth 2.0 tokens in the OS keychain (macOS, Linux) instead of a token file. Mutually exclusive with an explicit X_MCP_TOKEN_FILE.
environmentVariables.name: X_MCP_TOKEN_KEYCHAIN

environmentVariables.description: Policy preset: read-only (default), engage, publish, manage, or full.
environmentVariables.name: X_MCP_POLICY

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated op:domain cells to allow on top of the preset (e.g. read:dm,write:dm).
environmentVariables.name: X_MCP_POLICY_ALLOW

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated op:domain cells to deny; deny beats allow beats preset.
environmentVariables.name: X_MCP_POLICY_DENY

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to drop policy-denied tools from registration entirely instead of registering them annotated as denied.
environmentVariables.name: X_MCP_HIDE_DENIED

environmentVariables.description: Directory uploads must resolve inside. Media upload is disabled unless this is set.
environmentVariables.name: X_MCP_MEDIA_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated specially-provisioned access classes to declare: pilot, premium-user, enterprise. Unset means the conservative default (app+user, user-only).
environmentVariables.name: X_MCP_AVAILABILITY

environmentVariables.description: Path to a profiles file holding named configuration blocks.
environmentVariables.name: X_MCP_PROFILES_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Name of the profile to select from the profiles file.
environmentVariables.name: X_MCP_PROFILE

environmentVariables.description: Per-HTTP-request timeout in milliseconds (default 30000).
environmentVariables.name: X_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Diagnostic verbosity on stderr: silent, error, info (default), or debug.
environmentVariables.name: X_MCP_LOG_LEVEL

environmentVariables.description: Session spend cap in USD.
environmentVariables.name: X_MCP_CREDIT_BUDGET

environmentVariables.description: Budget enforcement: warn (default) or hard.
environmentVariables.name: X_MCP_BUDGET_MODE

server.name: io.github.IvanMurzak/Unity-MCP
server.description: Make games with AI: one MCP server that connects your agent to Unity, Unreal and Godot editors.
server.title: AI Game Developer: MCP for Unity, Unreal and Godot

environmentVariables.description: Client -> Server <- Plugin connection port (default: 8080)
environmentVariables.name: MCP_PLUGIN_PORT

environmentVariables.description: Plugin -> Server connection timeout (ms) (default: 10000). Tool calls use MCP_PLUGIN_TOOL_TIMEOUT instead.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_PLUGIN_CLIENT_TIMEOUT

environmentVariables.description: How long one tool call may run in the plugin (ms). A tool call is sent once and never re-sent (default: 300000, or MCP_PLUGIN_CLIENT_TIMEOUT if larger)
environmentVariables.name: MCP_PLUGIN_TOOL_TIMEOUT

environmentVariables.description: Client -> Server transport type: stdio or streamableHttp (default: stdio)
environmentVariables.name: MCP_PLUGIN_CLIENT_TRANSPORT

environmentVariables.description: Authentication mode: none or oauth. Default depends on transport: stdio -> none (offline/local/CI), streamableHttp -> oauth when MCP_AUTH_ISSUER + MCP_PUBLIC_URL are set, otherwise none. oauth validates ES256 JWTs (via cached JWKS) issued by MCP_AUTH_ISSUER, audienced to MCP_PUBLIC_URL.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH

environmentVariables.description: OAuth authorization-server URL (e.g. https://ai-game.dev). Required when MCP_AUTH=oauth.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_ISSUER

environmentVariables.description: This server's canonical public resource URL (its token audience, e.g. https://ai-game.dev/mcp). Required when MCP_AUTH=oauth; also seeds the Origin allow-list.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_PUBLIC_URL

environmentVariables.description: Network bind address: loopback (default), any (0.0.0.0), or a specific IP. Hosted deploys reachable by a reverse proxy set MCP_BIND=0.0.0.0.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_BIND

environmentVariables.description: Comma/semicolon-separated additional allowed Origins for browser clients (in addition to loopback + the MCP_PUBLIC_URL origin). Avoids a blanket wildcard on credentialed paths.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
